findings.title: Same-season prior-team minutes history is discarded for a transferred player
findings.mechanism: daily_forecast.py:654 filters to one team; daily_forecast.py:674-683 computes games_played, min_ewma, last_played and cold_start from that team-filtered frame.

findings.title: One identity can occupy two recency rosters and have her minutes attributed twice
findings.mechanism: daily_forecast.py:662-665 builds each roster from that team's own last RECENCY_GAMES games with no cross-team exclusivity check; daily_forecast.py:743 sums min_ewma per team.

findings.title: A designation published under the NEW team cannot bind, and the Phase-3 Out gate silently fails, until the master ingests a game for that team
findings.severity_proposed: A for the availability estimate, B while the player layer remains informational
findings.mechanism: daily_forecast.py:667-669 selects injury rows by franchise-name equality; daily_forecast.py:685 matches by normalized name within that team only; daily_forecast.py:731-735 degrades to WARN and states outright that the gate did not fire.
